test.query: WITH 'Many years later as he faced the firing squad, Colonel Aureliano Buendia was to remember that distant afternoon.' AS s SELECT replaceRegexpAll(materialize(s), ['[aeiou]+', '\\s+', 'Colonel (\\w+)', 'e.'][(number % 4) + 1], '_') FROM numbers_mt(500000) FORMAT Null

WITH 'Many years later as he faced the firing squad, Colonel Aureliano Buendia was to remember that distant afternoon.' AS s SELECT replaceRegexpAll(materialize(s), toLowCardinality(['[aeiou]+', '\\s+', 'Colonel (\\w+)', 'e.'][(number % 4) + 1]), '_') FROM numbers_mt(500000) FORMAT Null

WITH 'Many years later as he faced the firing squad, Colonel Aureliano Buendia was to remember that distant afternoon.' AS s SELECT replaceRegexpAll(materialize(s), ['[aeiou]+', '\\s+', 'Colonel (\\w+)', 'e.'][(number % 4) + 1], ['_', '-', ''][(number % 3) + 1]) FROM numbers_mt(500000) FORMAT Null

WITH arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(x -> if(cityHash64(x) % 2 = 0, 'a', 'b'), range(4000))) AS hs SELECT replaceRegexpAll(materialize(hs), concat('a[ab]{14}c', toString(number)), '_') FROM numbers_mt(500) FORMAT Null
